title: How much useful work do the configured resources produce?

panels.title: Loss tokens trained per second
panels.description: Latest useful loss-token throughput using core and full-cycle denominators. Higher is better at comparable workloads; a wide gap shows work outside the core reducing overall throughput. Each series shows its latest observed step; requires trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No training-metric observations. Check trainer.training_metrics and the selected Job/Execution.

panels.title: Useful tokens per configured role GPU-second
panels.description: Latest useful tokens per configured policy or inference GPU-second. Compare like workloads to spot declining resource efficiency. Denominators use GPU counts from the placement config; requires trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No training-metric observations. Check trainer.training_metrics and the selected Job/Execution.

panels.title: Configured role GPU counts
panels.description: Configured policy and inference GPU counts from the placement config, for the latest observed step. Use them to interpret per-GPU rates and check placement assumptions. Requires trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No training-metric observations. Check trainer.training_metrics and the selected Job/Execution.

panels.title: Cumulative core GPU-hours in selected window
panels.description: Cumulative configured GPU-hours in complete core-step observations inside the selected window, per execution. Compare useful work against this cost at matched configurations. Coverage is limited to complete core steps; requires trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No training-metric observations. Check trainer.training_metrics and the selected Job/Execution.
